# HUBB حُبّ

> HUBB is a Riyadh-packed in-shell sunflower-seed brand. Vacuum kernel infusion (~0.05 MPa) plus outer dust. The taste is in the kernel. الطعم في اللب.

Canonical site: https://hubb-seeds.onrender.com
Primary language: Arabic (Saudi Arabia)
Secondary language: English (Saudi Arabia)
Mill: Rozana, Riyadh. Public snack brand: HUBB / حُبّ.

## Accurate brand facts
- Promise: “الطعم في اللب / The taste is in the kernel.”
- Process: vacuum ~0.05 MPa, 60–70°C liquor through the husk; 72–100 mesh outer dust; roast 1.5–2.0% moisture; N2 pack.
- Packed in Riyadh. Halal. No masala on the front. No TCM/health claims.
- Retail (Panda / Othaim): umami salt, garlic, spice mix. Chocolate and coffee stay on e-com/café.
- Kernels stay naturally roasted gold — never a painted or green coating.
